observations: CAMSS attaches/links TITAN_TOP and releases it in camss_genpd_cleanup
I2C core dev_pm_domain_attach uses PD_FLAG_ATTACH_POWER_ON and PD_FLAG_DETACH_POWER_OFF for the DT sensor client
I2C adapter ignore_children is true; parent hierarchy does not give sensor independent domain ownership
Driver core runtime-resumes client before sensor remove
Current sensor node has MCLK4 clock but no power-domains property
reuse_decision: Use the existing retained shared-domain provider via standard DT/genpd ownership on the sensor; preserve clocks, sensor power order, graph, IRQ and all kernel modules
hypothesis: Independent runtime domain ownership allows sensor MCLK resume after CAMSS removal without relying on another consumer
